The hosted async-run stop called the base host with the shutdown deadline, then waited a second time for all tracked work without passing that deadline. Work ignoring the processing token could therefore prevent stop from returning after the budget expired. The additional drain now honors the remaining deadline and keeps draining normally when work settles in time. Revisited existing stop and task tracking contracts to trace both wait stages. The prior Aspects-added dispatch-slot branch and replay-cancellation changes are excluded. Defect ID aspects-async-run-stop-budget-ignored-by-supplemental-drain.

The gateway and refill forwarding trace establishes that a downstream asynchronous failure reaches the worker. Defect ID aspects-wallet-settlement-worker-aborts-on-item-timeout.

The browser ITSM correlation store selected at most 100 queued finding IDs but then cleared the entire set. Consume only the selected queue entries and give the one active batch responsibility for rescheduling its remainder. The actual store fixture tests an exact-size coalesced batch, an over-limit burst, advancement after a failed first batch and separately enqueued arrivals during a slow first response. Defect ID aspects-itsm-correlation-prefetch-discards-batch-tail.

Draft resume pagination ordered by UpdatedUtc alone. The database or in-memory enumeration can choose different orders for equal-time rows, causing consecutive pages to repeat and miss drafts even when the rows are unchanged. SQL now orders ties by unique DraftId descending, and in-memory uses the corresponding SqlGuid comparer. The architecture-specific list already defines that SQL tie-break and supplied the convention; its query remains a separate path. Defect ID aspects-draft-resume-page-order-equal-updated-timestamps.

The scanner queried a single rolling 24-hour interval and counted only the dictionary entry at exact caller FromUtc. The SQL reader already filters source events on the half-open interval, but its DATEADD/DATEDIFF_BIG grouping can return a different bucket label and a second bucket for findings observed in the final fractional second. The scanner now sums returned open-findings buckets for that bounded interval. A .NET Release fixture ran the extracted production measurement method with modeled SQL boundary and datetime round-trip behavior. Revisited only the in-memory bucket calculation to verify the provider difference. Defect ID aspects-compliance-drift-scanner-drops-in-window-findings-by-bucket-anchor.
